title_en: Allama al-Haydari's Stance on the Issue of Seeing the Expected Imam al-Hujja (may God hasten his advent) During the Era of the Greater Occultation
summary: An explanatory segment detailing the specific view of religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on whether personal sightings of the awaited Imam are possible during the Greater Occultation.
